# Jeff Cady Security

> vCISO advisory, security consulting and incident response for organizations without a full-time CISO, plus hands-on recovery for older adults who have been hacked or scammed. Jeff Cady, CISSP, JCady LLC, Maricopa County, Arizona; remote, with on-site visits available. Contact: jeff@jcady.org, (520) 223-9878 ext. 800.

## Pages

- [vCISO, consulting and incident response](https://security.jcady.org/): services, retainers, assessments, the office checkup and sample deliverables, contact
- [Hacked or scammed? Recovery help for older adults](https://security.jcady.org/er.html): devices cleaned, accounts secured, everything explained in plain language
- [Cyber insurance readiness](https://security.jcady.org/insurance.html): a fixed-price readiness report and a controls summary for your broker
- [Security Readiness Check](https://security.jcady.org/rc.html): a free 5-minute check based on CISA's Cybersecurity Performance Goals and the NIST CSF, with a PDF report

## Free help after a scam or hack

- [First-hour steps](https://familysecurityplaybook.com/help-now/)
- [Write down what happened](https://familysecurityplaybook.com/help-now/record): a step-by-step record of times, names, amounts and calls

## Related

- [Family Security Playbook](https://familysecurityplaybook.com/): printed security playbooks for families and small offices
